paragraphs: R. Chanina Shalka, in Rav's time—I have not found this. Esther Rabbah, on “The king appointed”: R. Chanina bar Shalka, R. Yehoshua of Sikhnin, and R. Levi, in R. Yochanan's name. Tanchuma, Tetze: R. Chama bar Shikla, R. Yehoshua ben Levi, and R. Yochanan. Shocher Tov on Samuel, chapter 14: R. Chama ben Shalda and R. Yehoshua of Sikhnin. See Acha bar Shalka.
